title: FundingSource
description: A budget, grant, fund or facility that work draws money from, declared once and referenced by every funding line that draws on it. Standalone for the reason every catalogue here is: the identifier belongs to the budget, not to one project's use of it, so it is written where it cannot be mistyped per project. Until 2026-09-29 a funding line carried two free-text boxes instead — which budget, and a reference whose placeholder read "Head 26-02-001", a code nobody could tell the purpose of and nothing could check (Programme Lead, 2026-09-29). Not a Resource: a Resource is what a project draws on to do the work, and money is what it draws on to pay for it. See TAXONOMY.md D7.

name.description: What this budget is called by the people who hold it.

code.description: How this budget is identified in the ledger it belongs to — a head, a subhead, a fund or a grant number. Free text because it is somebody else's identifier and Cartograph cannot check it, but written once here rather than re-typed on every project that draws on it. Optional: not every organisation codes its budgets.

heldBy.description: The unit or party that holds this budget and answers for it. A reference to the catalogue, so the body is named once wherever it appears.

period.description: What span this budget covers, as the organisation names it: a financial year, a season, a grant term. Free text because a financial year is not a date range everybody starts in January.

note.description: Anything about this budget the fields above cannot hold.
